items.title: Why Booking Holdings (BKNG) Is Getting Attention Today
items.summary: Booking Holdings (BKNG) has pushed further into AI-driven trip planning after expanding Vayo, its personal travel agent. It now books flights, stays, transport, activities and more within a single conversation for private beta users. For investors, the backdrop is more mixed than the product news suggests.
